text.p: Tropical Cyclone Justin, with 85 mph winds, is in the Coral Sea to the southeast of New Guinea and well to the east of Queensland Australia. Justin is expected to strengthen as it drifts west and then moves southwest during this period. It is mainly a strong risk to shipping and to boating in the eastern Coral Sea during this period.

Tropical Cyclone Hina, with 65 mph winds, is in the Southern Pacific Ocean near 26.2s/169.8w, moving southeast at 22 mph. Hina is expected to weaken and lose tropical characteristics during the next 48 hours, while moving rapidly southeastward. The storm threatens only shipping.
There are no further emergency statements at this time.
